ko.title: 10월 1일 시행되는 SNAP 변경 사항: 가구, 주 정부 및 식료품점이 알아야 할 사항

segments.src: A new federal fiscal year began on October 1, and with it came another stage of changes to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), the nation's largest food assistance program.
segments.tr: 10월 1일에 새로운 연방 회계연도가 시작되면서 미국 최대의 식품 지원 프로그램인 보충 영양 지원 프로그램(SNAP)에 또 다른 단계의 변화가 찾아왔습니다.

segments.src: Recipients, state agencies and grocery retailers are all adjusting.
segments.tr: 수혜자, 주 정부 기관, 식료품 소매업체 모두 이에 적응하고 있습니다.

segments.src: This guide explains who is affected, what may look different at the checkout and in the application process, and where to get reliable, current information.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 누가 영향을 받는지, 결제 및 신청 과정에서 무엇이 달라질 수 있는지, 신뢰할 수 있는 최신 정보를 어디서 얻을 수 있는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: > **A note on accuracy:** SNAP rules are set by federal law but administered by states, so timing and details can differ by state. Treat this article as a general overview and confirm specifics with your state SNAP agency.
segments.tr: > **정확성에 대한 참고 사항:** SNAP 규정은 연방법에 의해 제정되지만 주 정부에서 집행하므로 시기와 세부 사항은 주마다 다를 수 있습니다. 이 글은 일반적인 개요로 참고하시고, 구체적인 내용은 해당 주의 SNAP 담당 기관에 확인하시기 바랍니다.

segments.src: ## Why the changes are happening now
segments.tr: ## 변경 사항이 지금 발생하는 이유

segments.src: Many of the recent adjustments trace back to the federal budget and tax law signed in July 2025, which made several changes to SNAP eligibility and financing.
segments.tr: 최근의 많은 조정 사항은 2025년 7월에 서명된 연방 예산 및 세법으로 거슬러 올라가며, 이 법은 SNAP 자격 및 재정 지원에 몇 가지 변화를 가져왔습니다.

segments.src: Some provisions took effect soon after enactment.
segments.tr: 일부 조항은 제정 직후 효력을 발휘했습니다.

segments.src: Others are phased in on the start of a fiscal year, which is why October 1 is an important date for administrators and participants alike.
segments.tr: 다른 조항들은 회계연도 시작과 함께 단계적으로 도입되고 있으며, 이것이 10월 1일이 관리자와 참가자 모두에게 중요한 날짜인 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## 영향 대상자

segments.src: ### Adults subject to work requirements
segments.tr: ### 근로 요건이 적용되는 성인

segments.src: Federal rules have long required certain adults without dependents to work or take part in qualifying activities for a minimum number of hours per week to keep benefits beyond a limited period.
segments.tr: 연방 규정은 오랫동안 부양가족이 없는 특정 성인이 제한된 기간을 초과하여 혜택을 유지하려면 주당 최소 시간 동안 일하거나 자격 요건을 충족하는 활동에 참여하도록 요구해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Recent changes widened the group of people who must meet these rules and narrowed some of the exemptions that previously applied.
segments.tr: 최근 변경 사항으로 인해 이러한 규정을 충족해야 하는 대상 범위가 넓어졌고, 이전에 적용되던 일부 면제 혜택은 축소되었습니다.

segments.src: Depending on your situation, the requirements may now apply to:
segments.tr: 귀하의 상황에 따라 이제 다음과 같은 경우에 요건이 적용될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - Older adults in a higher age range than before
segments.tr: - 이전보다 더 높은 연령대에 속하는 고령자

segments.src: - Some parents whose children are older than a certain age
segments.tr: - 자녀가 특정 연령 이상인 일부 부모

segments.src: - People in groups that previously qualified for exemptions
segments.tr: - 이전에 면제 자격이 주어졌던 그룹에 속한 사람들

segments.src: Exemptions still exist, including for people who are medically unable to work, pregnant, or caring for young children or an incapacitated household member.
segments.tr: 의학적으로 근로가 불가능하거나, 임신 중이거나, 어린 자녀 또는 거동이 불편한 가구원을 돌보는 사람 등을 위한 면제 조항은 여전히 존재합니다.

segments.src: If you think you qualify for an exemption, ask your caseworker how to document it.
segments.tr: 면제 자격이 된다고 생각되면 담당 사회복지사에게 증빙 방법을 문의하십시오.

segments.src: ### Certain noncitizens
segments.tr: ### 특정 비시민권자

segments.src: Eligibility categories for some lawfully present noncitizens have been narrowed.
segments.tr: 합법적으로 체류 중인 일부 비시민권자의 자격 카테고리가 축소되었습니다.

segments.src: Households with mixed immigration status should check with their state agency or a trusted legal aid or community organization before assuming they are or are not eligible.
segments.tr: 이민 신분이 혼합된 가구는 자격 여부를 예단하기 전에 주 정부 기관이나 신뢰할 수 있는 법률 지원 또는 지역사회 단체에 확인해야 합니다.

segments.src: Importantly, U.S.
segments.tr: 중요한 점은, 가구 내 미국

segments.src: citizen children in a household generally keep their own eligibility.
segments.tr: 시민권자 자녀는 일반적으로 자체적인 자격을 유지한다는 것입니다.

segments.src: ### Households with utility costs
segments.tr: ### 공과금 비용이 발생하는 가구

segments.src: SNAP benefit amounts take into account certain housing and utility expenses.
segments.tr: SNAP 혜택 금액은 특정 주거비 및 공과금 비용을 고려하여 산정됩니다.

segments.src: Changes to how some utility costs are counted, including how internet costs and energy-assistance links are treated, can alter the deductions a household receives.
segments.tr: 인터넷 비용 및 에너지 지원 연계 처리 방식을 포함하여 일부 공과금 비용을 계산하는 방식이 변경됨에 따라 가구가 받는 공제액이 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For some households, that may mean a different monthly benefit.
segments.tr: 일부 가구의 경우, 이는 월별 혜택 금액의 변화를 의미할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Households with elderly or disabled members may be treated differently from others.
segments.tr: 고령자나 장애인이 있는 가구는 다른 가구와 다르게 취급될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What changes at the checkout
segments.tr: ## 결제 시 달라지는 점

segments.src: For most shoppers, using an EBT card at the register works the way it did before.
segments.tr: 대부분의 쇼핑객에게 계산대에서 EBT 카드를 사용하는 방식은 이전과 동일합니다.

segments.src: A few things are worth knowing:
segments.tr: 다만 몇 가지 알아두어야 할 사항이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Eligible items remain the same in most places.** SNAP still covers food for home preparation, such as produce, meat, dairy, grains and pantry staples. It does not cover alcohol, tobacco, hot prepared foods or non-food items.
segments.tr: - **대부분의 지역에서 구매 가능 품목은 동일하게 유지됩니다.** SNAP은 여전히 농산물, 육류, 유제품, 곡물 및 기본 식료품과 같이 가정에서 조리하기 위한 식품을 지원합니다. 주류, 담배, 뜨거운 조리 식품 또는 비식품류는 지원하지 않습니다.

segments.src: - **Some states are testing purchase restrictions.** A number of states have sought federal approval to limit SNAP purchases of items such as soda or candy. If your state has such a waiver, you may see certain products declined at checkout. Your state agency will publish the start date and the list of affected items.
segments.tr: - **일부 주에서는 구매 제한을 테스트하고 있습니다.** 여러 주에서 탄산음료나 사탕 같은 품목의 SNAP 구매를 제한하기 위해 연방 정부의 승인을 요청했습니다. 귀하의 주에 이러한 면제 조치가 적용되는 경우, 결제 시 특정 제품의 승인이 거절될 수 있습니다. 해당 주 정부 기관에서 시작일과 대상 품목 목록을 공지할 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Benefit amounts may differ.** If your monthly benefit has changed, you will see it reflected when funds are loaded onto your card. Check your balance through your state EBT app or the number on the back of your card before you shop.
segments.tr: - **혜택 금액이 달라질 수 있습니다.** 월별 혜택 금액이 변경된 경우, 카드로 자금이 충전될 때 반영된 것을 확인할 수 있습니다. 쇼핑하기 전에 주의 EBT 앱이나 카드 뒷면에 있는 번호를 통해 잔액을 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - **Card security matters.** Card skimming and theft have been a concern in several states. Checking your balance regularly, changing your PIN and reporting problems quickly can help. Ask your state agency about replacement policies if benefits are stolen.
segments.tr: - **카드 보안이 중요합니다.** 여러 주에서 카드 복제(스키밍) 및 도난이 문제가 되고 있습니다. 정기적으로 잔액을 확인하고, PIN 번호를 변경하고, 문제를 신속하게 신고하는 것이 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 혜택을 도난당한 경우의 재발급 정책에 대해 주 정부 기관에 문의하십시오.

segments.src: ## What changes in the application and renewal process
segments.tr: ## 신청 및 갱신 과정에서 달라지는 점

segments.src: Applicants and current recipients may notice more paperwork and more follow-up:
segments.tr: 신청자와 기존 수혜자는 더 많은 서류 제출과 후속 조치를 경험할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 1. **Documentation.** Expect requests to verify work hours, exemptions, immigration status or expenses. Keep pay stubs, medical notes, lease and utility bills ready.
segments.tr: 1. **증빙 서류.** 근로 시간, 면제 사유, 이민 신분 또는 지출 비용을 증명하라는 요청에 대비하십시오. 급여 명세서, 진단서, 임대차 계약서 및 공과금 고지서를 미리 준비해 두십시오.

segments.src: 2. **Notices and deadlines.** Watch your mail, email and state benefits portal. Missing a notice or deadline is one of the most common reasons benefits are interrupted.
segments.tr: 2. **통지 및 마감일.** 우편물, 이메일 및 주 정부 혜택 포털을 주의 깊게 확인하십시오. 통지나 마감일을 놓치는 것은 혜택이 중단되는 가장 흔한 원인 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: 3. **Interviews.** Many states still require an interview at application and recertification. Confirm your appointment and respond promptly if you need to reschedule.
segments.tr: 3. **인터뷰.** 많은 주에서 신청 및 재인증 시 여전히 인터뷰를 요구합니다. 예약 일정을 확인하고, 일정을 변경해야 하는 경우 신속하게 응답하십시오.

segments.src: 4. **Reporting changes.** Changes in income, household size or work hours may need to be reported on a schedule set by your state.
segments.tr: 4. **변동 사항 보고.** 소득, 가구원 수 또는 근로 시간의 변동은 해당 주에서 정한 일정에 따라 보고해야 할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 5. **Appeals.** If you receive a denial or reduction you believe is wrong, you generally have the right to request a fair hearing. The notice should include the deadline and instructions.
segments.tr: 5. **이의 신청.** 거부 또는 감액 결정이 잘못되었다고 생각되면 일반적으로 공정한 심리를 요청할 권리가 있습니다. 통지서에 마감일과 안내 사항이 포함되어 있어야 합니다.

segments.src: ## What states are dealing with
segments.tr: ## 주 정부가 직면한 과제

segments.src: States run SNAP day to day, and the financing structure is shifting.
segments.tr: 주 정부는 SNAP을 일상적으로 운영하며, 재정 지원 구조가 변화하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Beginning in fiscal year 2027, the federal share of state administrative costs is scheduled to fall, leaving states to cover a larger portion of the expense of processing applications, verifying eligibility and operating call centers.
segments.tr: 2027 회계연도부터 주 행정 비용에 대한 연방 정부의 분담 비율이 감소할 예정이어서, 신청 처리, 자격 검증 및 콜센터 운영 비용의 더 많은 부분을 주 정부가 부담하게 됩니다.

segments.src: Further changes tied to state payment error rates and benefit cost sharing are scheduled in later years.
segments.tr: 향후에는 주의 지급 오류율 및 혜택 비용 분담과 관련된 추가 변경 사항도 예정되어 있습니다.

segments.src: State agencies have responded in different ways, including updating computer systems, training staff, hiring or reallocating workers, and notifying participants.
segments.tr: 주 정부 기관들은 컴퓨터 시스템 업데이트, 직원 교육, 인력 채용 또는 재배치, 참가자 통지 등 다양한 방식으로 대응해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Advocates and some officials have raised concerns about processing delays and wait times.
segments.tr: 옹호 단체와 일부 공무원들은 처리 지연과 대기 시간에 대한 우려를 제기했습니다.

segments.src: Others argue the changes encourage accuracy and work participation.
segments.tr: 다른 이들은 이러한 변화가 정확성을 높이고 근로 참여를 독려한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Either way, the practical effect for families can vary widely depending on where they live.
segments.tr: 어느 쪽이든, 가정이 체감하는 실질적인 영향은 거주 지역에 따라 크게 다를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What grocers and retailers are doing
segments.tr: ## 식료품점 및 소매업체의 대응

segments.src: Authorized SNAP retailers, from large chains to corner stores and farmers markets, are updating point-of-sale systems and staff training.
segments.tr: 대형 체인점부터 골목 상권, 파머스 마켓에 이르기까지 승인된 SNAP 소매업체들은 결제 시스템(POS)을 업데이트하고 직원 교육을 실시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Key points for retailers:
segments.tr: 소매업체를 위한 핵심 사항은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: - Follow state guidance on any product restrictions and update registers accordingly.
segments.tr: - 제품 제한에 대한 주 정부의 지침을 따르고 이에 맞춰 결제 단말기를 업데이트하십시오.

segments.src: - Train cashiers to explain declined items calmly, since shoppers may be surprised.
segments.tr: - 쇼핑객이 당황할 수 있으므로, 계산원이 승인 거절된 품목에 대해 차분하게 설명할 수 있도록 교육하십시오.

segments.src: - Watch for changes in sales volume if household benefits shift in your area.
segments.tr: - 해당 지역의 가구 혜택이 변동되는 경우 매출액의 변화를 주시하십시오.

segments.src: - Keep informed through USDA Food and Nutrition Service retailer resources.
segments.tr: - USDA 식품영양국의 소매업체 리소스를 통해 최신 정보를 파악하십시오.

segments.src: ## Practical steps for households
segments.tr: ## 가구를 위한 실천 단계

segments.src: - **Log in or call now.** Verify your case status, benefit amount and any upcoming deadline.
segments.tr: - **지금 로그인하거나 전화하십시오.** 케이스 상태, 혜택 금액 및 다가오는 마감일을 확인하십시오.

segments.src: - **Gather documents.** Proof of work hours, exemptions, income and expenses can speed up decisions.
segments.tr: - **서류를 준비하십시오.** 근로 시간, 면제 사유, 소득 및 지출 증빙 자료는 결정을 신속하게 진행하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Ask about exemptions and deductions.** You may qualify for something you did not know about.
segments.tr: - **면제 및 공제 혜택에 대해 문의하십시오.** 미처 알지 못했던 혜택 자격이 있을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Do not wait for a cutoff.** If you receive a notice, respond early and keep copies.
segments.tr: - **중단될 때까지 기다리지 마십시오.** 통지서를 받으면 신속하게 응답하고 사본을 보관하십시오.

segments.src: - **Use local help.** Food banks, community action agencies, legal aid groups and 211 can help with applications, appeals and emergency food.
segments.tr: - **지역 지원을 활용하십시오.** 푸드뱅크, 지역사회 행동 기관, 법률 지원 단체 및 211을 통해 신청, 이의 신청 및 긴급 식품 지원을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.tr: ## 신뢰할 수 있는 정보를 찾을 수 있는 곳

segments.src: - Your state SNAP or human services agency website and hotline
segments.tr: - 해당 주의 SNAP 또는 복지 부서 웹사이트 및 핫라인

segments.tr: - 지역 푸드뱅크 및 지역사회 단체

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: The changes that take effect this fiscal year affect different people in different ways.
segments.tr: 이번 회계연도에 시행되는 변경 사항은 사람마다 다른 방식으로 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: Some households will see little difference; others may face new work rules, eligibility questions or different benefit amounts.

segments.src: ## Why the changes are happening now

segments.src: Many of the recent adjustments trace back to the federal budget and tax law signed in July 2025, which made several changes to SNAP eligibility and financing.

segments.src: ### Adults subject to work requirements
segments.tr: ### Adults subject to work requirements

segments.src: Federal rules have long required certain adults without dependents to work or take part in qualifying activities for a minimum number of hours per week to keep benefits beyond a limited period.
segments.tr: Federal rules have long required certain adults without dependents to work or take part in qualifying activities for a minimum number of hours per week to keep benefits beyond a limited period.

segments.src: Recent changes widened the group of people who must meet these rules and narrowed some of the exemptions that previously applied.
segments.tr: Recent changes widened the group of people who must meet these rules and narrowed some of the exemptions that previously applied.

segments.tr: - People in groups that previously qualified for exemptions

segments.src: ## What changes at the checkout
segments.tr: ## What changes at the checkout

segments.src: For most shoppers, using an EBT card at the register works the way it did before.
segments.tr: For most shoppers, using an EBT card at the register works the way it did before.

segments.src: A few things are worth knowing:
segments.tr: A few things are worth knowing:

segments.src: - **Eligible items remain the same in most places.** SNAP still covers food for home preparation, such as produce, meat, dairy, grains and pantry staples. It does not cover alcohol, tobacco, hot prepared foods or non-food items.
segments.tr: - **Eligible items remain the same in most places.** SNAP still covers food for home preparation, such as produce, meat, dairy, grains and pantry staples. It does not cover alcohol, tobacco, hot prepared foods or non-food items.

segments.src: - **Some states are testing purchase restrictions.** A number of states have sought federal approval to limit SNAP purchases of items such as soda or candy. If your state has such a waiver, you may see certain products declined at checkout. Your state agency will publish the start date and the list of affected items.
segments.tr: - **Some states are testing purchase restrictions.** A number of states have sought federal approval to limit SNAP purchases of items such as soda or candy. If your state has such a waiver, you may see certain products declined at checkout. Your state agency will publish the start date and the list of affected items.

segments.src: - **Benefit amounts may differ.** If your monthly benefit has changed, you will see it reflected when funds are loaded onto your card. Check your balance through your state EBT app or the number on the back of your card before you shop.
segments.tr: - **Benefit amounts may differ.** If your monthly benefit has changed, you will see it reflected when funds are loaded onto your card. Check your balance through your state EBT app or the number on the back of your card before you shop.

segments.src: - **Card security matters.** Card skimming and theft have been a concern in several states. Checking your balance regularly, changing your PIN and reporting problems quickly can help. Ask your state agency about replacement policies if benefits are stolen.

segments.src: ## What changes in the application and renewal process
segments.tr: ## What changes in the application and renewal process

segments.src: Applicants and current recipients may notice more paperwork and more follow-up:
segments.tr: Applicants and current recipients may notice more paperwork and more follow-up:

segments.src: 1. **Documentation.** Expect requests to verify work hours, exemptions, immigration status or expenses. Keep pay stubs, medical notes, lease and utility bills ready.
segments.tr: 1. **Documentation.** Expect requests to verify work hours, exemptions, immigration status or expenses. Keep pay stubs, medical notes, lease and utility bills ready.

segments.src: 2. **Notices and deadlines.** Watch your mail, email and state benefits portal. Missing a notice or deadline is one of the most common reasons benefits are interrupted.
segments.tr: 2. **Notices and deadlines.** Watch your mail, email and state benefits portal. Missing a notice or deadline is one of the most common reasons benefits are interrupted.

segments.src: 3. **Interviews.** Many states still require an interview at application and recertification. Confirm your appointment and respond promptly if you need to reschedule.
segments.tr: 3. **Interviews.** Many states still require an interview at application and recertification. Confirm your appointment and respond promptly if you need to reschedule.

segments.src: 4. **Reporting changes.** Changes in income, household size or work hours may need to be reported on a schedule set by your state.
segments.tr: 4. **Reporting changes.** Changes in income, household size or work hours may need to be reported on a schedule set by your state.

segments.src: 5. **Appeals.** If you receive a denial or reduction you believe is wrong, you generally have the right to request a fair hearing. The notice should include the deadline and instructions.
segments.tr: 5. **Appeals.** If you receive a denial or reduction you believe is wrong, you generally have the right to request a fair hearing. The notice should include the deadline and instructions.

segments.src: ## What states are dealing with
segments.tr: ## What states are dealing with

segments.src: States run SNAP day to day, and the financing structure is shifting.
segments.tr: States run SNAP day to day, and the financing structure is shifting.

segments.src: Beginning in fiscal year 2027, the federal share of state administrative costs is scheduled to fall, leaving states to cover a larger portion of the expense of processing applications, verifying eligibility and operating call centers.
segments.tr: Beginning in fiscal year 2027, the federal share of state administrative costs is scheduled to fall, leaving states to cover a larger portion of the expense of processing applications, verifying eligibility and operating call centers.

segments.src: Further changes tied to state payment error rates and benefit cost sharing are scheduled in later years.
segments.tr: Further changes tied to state payment error rates and benefit cost sharing are scheduled in later years.

segments.src: State agencies have responded in different ways, including updating computer systems, training staff, hiring or reallocating workers, and notifying participants.
segments.tr: State agencies have responded in different ways, including updating computer systems, training staff, hiring or reallocating workers, and notifying participants.

segments.src: Advocates and some officials have raised concerns about processing delays and wait times.
segments.tr: Advocates and some officials have raised concerns about processing delays and wait times.

segments.src: Others argue the changes encourage accuracy and work participation.
segments.tr: Others argue the changes encourage accuracy and work participation.

segments.tr: कुछ उपयोगिता लागतों की गणना कैसे की जाती है, जिसमें इंटरनेट लागत और ऊर्जा-सहायता लिंक के साथ कैसा व्यवहार किया जाता है, इसमें बदलाव से परिवार को मिलने वाली कटौती बदल सकती है।

segments.src: For some households, that may mean a different monthly benefit.
segments.tr: कुछ परिवारों के लिए, इसका मतलब एक अलग मासिक लाभ हो सकता है।

segments.src: Households with elderly or disabled members may be treated differently from others.
segments.tr: बुजुर्ग या विकलांग सदस्यों वाले परिवारों के साथ दूसरों की तुलना में अलग व्यवहार किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: ## What changes at the checkout
segments.tr: ## चेकआउट पर क्या बदलता है

segments.src: For most shoppers, using an EBT card at the register works the way it did before.
segments.tr: अधिकांश खरीदारों के लिए, रजिस्टर पर EBT कार्ड का उपयोग करना पहले की तरह ही काम करता है।

segments.src: A few things are worth knowing:
segments.tr: कुछ बातें जानने योग्य हैं:

segments.src: - **Eligible items remain the same in most places.** SNAP still covers food for home preparation, such as produce, meat, dairy, grains and pantry staples. It does not cover alcohol, tobacco, hot prepared foods or non-food items.
segments.tr: - **अधिकांश स्थानों पर पात्र वस्तुएं वही रहेंगी।** SNAP अभी भी घर पर तैयार किए जाने वाले भोजन को कवर करता है, जैसे कि फल-सब्जियां, मांस, डेयरी, अनाज और पेंट्री की बुनियादी चीजें। यह शराब, तंबाकू, गर्म तैयार भोजन या गैर-खाद्य वस्तुओं को कवर नहीं करता है।

segments.src: - **Some states are testing purchase restrictions.** A number of states have sought federal approval to limit SNAP purchases of items such as soda or candy. If your state has such a waiver, you may see certain products declined at checkout. Your state agency will publish the start date and the list of affected items.
segments.tr: - **कुछ राज्य खरीद प्रतिबंधों का परीक्षण कर रहे हैं।** कई राज्यों ने सोडा या कैंडी जैसी वस्तुओं की SNAP खरीद को सीमित करने के लिए संघीय मंजूरी मांगी है। यदि आपके राज्य में ऐसी छूट है, तो आप चेकआउट के समय कुछ उत्पादों को अस्वीकृत होते देख सकते हैं। आपकी राज्य एजेंसी इसकी शुरुआत की तारीख और प्रभावित वस्तुओं की सूची प्रकाशित करेगी।

segments.src: - **Benefit amounts may differ.** If your monthly benefit has changed, you will see it reflected when funds are loaded onto your card. Check your balance through your state EBT app or the number on the back of your card before you shop.
segments.tr: - **लाभ की राशि भिन्न हो सकती है।** यदि आपका मासिक लाभ बदल गया है, तो आपके कार्ड में धनराशि लोड होने पर आपको यह दिखाई देगा। खरीदारी करने से पहले अपने राज्य के EBT ऐप या अपने कार्ड के पीछे दिए गए नंबर के माध्यम से अपना बैलेंस जांचें।

segments.src: - **Card security matters.** Card skimming and theft have been a concern in several states. Checking your balance regularly, changing your PIN and reporting problems quickly can help. Ask your state agency about replacement policies if benefits are stolen.
segments.tr: - **कार्ड सुरक्षा महत्वपूर्ण है।** कई राज्यों में कार्ड स्किमिंग और चोरी एक चिंता का विषय रही है। नियमित रूप से अपना बैलेंस जांचना, अपना पिन बदलना और समस्याओं की तुरंत रिपोर्ट करना मददगार हो सकता है। यदि लाभ चोरी हो जाते हैं तो प्रतिस्थापन नीतियों के बारे में अपनी राज्य एजेंसी से पूछें।

segments.src: ## What changes in the application and renewal process
segments.tr: ## आवेदन और नवीनीकरण प्रक्रिया में क्या बदलता है

segments.src: Applicants and current recipients may notice more paperwork and more follow-up:
segments.tr: आवेदक और वर्तमान लाभार्थी अधिक कागजी कार्रवाई और अधिक फॉलो-अप देख सकते हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Documentation.** Expect requests to verify work hours, exemptions, immigration status or expenses. Keep pay stubs, medical notes, lease and utility bills ready.
segments.tr: 1. **दस्तावेज़ीकरण।** काम के घंटे, छूट, आव्रजन स्थिति या खर्चों को सत्यापित करने के अनुरोधों की अपेक्षा करें। वेतन पर्ची, मेडिकल नोट्स, लीज और उपयोगिता बिल तैयार रखें।

segments.src: 2. **Notices and deadlines.** Watch your mail, email and state benefits portal. Missing a notice or deadline is one of the most common reasons benefits are interrupted.
segments.tr: 2. **नोटिस और समय सीमा।** अपने मेल, ईमेल और राज्य लाभ पोर्टल पर नज़र रखें। नोटिस या समय सीमा चूकना लाभों में रुकावट आने के सबसे आम कारणों में से एक है।

segments.src: 3. **Interviews.** Many states still require an interview at application and recertification. Confirm your appointment and respond promptly if you need to reschedule.
segments.tr: 3. **साक्षात्कार।** कई राज्यों में अभी भी आवेदन और पुन: प्रमाणन के समय साक्षात्कार की आवश्यकता होती है। अपनी नियुक्ति की पुष्टि करें और यदि आपको पुनर्निर्धारित करने की आवश्यकता है तो तुरंत प्रतिक्रिया दें।

segments.src: 4. **Reporting changes.** Changes in income, household size or work hours may need to be reported on a schedule set by your state.
segments.tr: 4. **बदलावों की रिपोर्ट करना।** आय, परिवार के आकार या काम के घंटों में बदलाव की रिपोर्ट आपके राज्य द्वारा निर्धारित कार्यक्रम के अनुसार की जानी चाहिए।

segments.src: 5. **Appeals.** If you receive a denial or reduction you believe is wrong, you generally have the right to request a fair hearing. The notice should include the deadline and instructions.
segments.tr: 5. **अपील।** यदि आपको कोई अस्वीकृति या कटौती प्राप्त होती है जो आपको लगता है कि गलत है, तो आपको आम तौर पर निष्पक्ष सुनवाई का अनुरोध करने का अधिकार है। नोटिस में समय सीमा और निर्देश शामिल होने चाहिए।

segments.src: ## What states are dealing with
segments.tr: ## राज्य किस स्थिति से निपट रहे हैं

segments.src: States run SNAP day to day, and the financing structure is shifting.
segments.tr: राज्य दिन-प्रतिदिन SNAP चलाते हैं, और वित्तपोषण संरचना बदल रही है।

segments.src: Beginning in fiscal year 2027, the federal share of state administrative costs is scheduled to fall, leaving states to cover a larger portion of the expense of processing applications, verifying eligibility and operating call centers.
segments.tr: वित्तीय वर्ष 2027 से शुरू होकर, राज्य की प्रशासनिक लागतों में संघीय हिस्सेदारी कम होने वाली है, जिससे राज्यों को आवेदनों को संसाधित करने, पात्रता की पुष्टि करने और कॉल सेंटर संचालित करने के खर्च का एक बड़ा हिस्सा खुद वहन करना होगा।

segments.src: Further changes tied to state payment error rates and benefit cost sharing are scheduled in later years.
segments.tr: राज्य भुगतान त्रुटि दरों और लाभ लागत साझाकरण से जुड़े आगे के बदलाव बाद के वर्षों में निर्धारित हैं।

segments.src: State agencies have responded in different ways, including updating computer systems, training staff, hiring or reallocating workers, and notifying participants.
segments.tr: राज्य एजेंसियों ने अलग-अलग तरीकों से प्रतिक्रिया दी है, जिसमें कंप्यूटर सिस्टम को अपडेट करना, कर्मचारियों को प्रशिक्षित करना, श्रमिकों को काम पर रखना या पुनर्वितरित करना और प्रतिभागियों को सूचित करना शामिल है।

segments.src: Advocates and some officials have raised concerns about processing delays and wait times.
segments.tr: अधिवक्ताओं और कुछ अधिकारियों ने प्रसंस्करण में देरी और प्रतीक्षा समय के बारे में चिंताएं जताई हैं।

segments.src: Others argue the changes encourage accuracy and work participation.
segments.tr: दूसरों का तर्क है कि ये बदलाव सटीकता और काम में भागीदारी को बढ़ावा देते हैं।

segments.src: Either way, the practical effect for families can vary widely depending on where they live.
segments.tr: जो भी हो, परिवारों के लिए व्यावहारिक प्रभाव इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि वे कहाँ रहते हैं।

segments.src: ## What grocers and retailers are doing
segments.tr: ## किराना और खुदरा विक्रेता क्या कर रहे हैं

segments.src: Authorized SNAP retailers, from large chains to corner stores and farmers markets, are updating point-of-sale systems and staff training.
segments.tr: अधिकृत SNAP खुदरा विक्रेता, बड़ी श्रृंखलाओं से लेकर कोने की दुकानों और किसान बाजारों तक, पॉइंट-ऑफ-सेल सिस्टम और कर्मचारियों के प्रशिक्षण को अपडेट कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: Key points for retailers:
segments.tr: खुदरा विक्रेताओं के लिए मुख्य बिंदु:

segments.src: - Follow state guidance on any product restrictions and update registers accordingly.
segments.tr: - किसी भी उत्पाद प्रतिबंध पर राज्य के दिशानिर्देशों का पालन करें और तदनुसार रजिस्टरों को अपडेट करें।

segments.src: - Train cashiers to explain declined items calmly, since shoppers may be surprised.
segments.tr: - कैशियरों को अस्वीकृत वस्तुओं के बारे में शांति से समझाने के लिए प्रशिक्षित करें, क्योंकि खरीदार हैरान हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - Watch for changes in sales volume if household benefits shift in your area.
segments.tr: - यदि आपके क्षेत्र में पारिवारिक लाभों में बदलाव होता है तो बिक्री की मात्रा में बदलाव पर नज़र रखें।

segments.src: - Keep informed through USDA Food and Nutrition Service retailer resources.
segments.tr: - USDA खाद्य और पोषण सेवा खुदरा विक्रेता संसाधनों के माध्यम से सूचित रहें।

segments.src: ## Practical steps for households
segments.tr: ## परिवारों के लिए व्यावहारिक कदम

segments.src: - **Log in or call now.** Verify your case status, benefit amount and any upcoming deadline.
segments.tr: - **अभी लॉग इन करें या कॉल करें।** अपने मामले की स्थिति, लाभ की राशि और किसी भी आगामी समय सीमा को सत्यापित करें।

segments.src: - **Gather documents.** Proof of work hours, exemptions, income and expenses can speed up decisions.
segments.tr: - **दस्तावेज़ इकट्ठा करें।** काम के घंटे, छूट, आय और खर्चों का प्रमाण निर्णयों को गति दे सकता है।

segments.src: - **Ask about exemptions and deductions.** You may qualify for something you did not know about.
segments.tr: - **छूट और कटौती के बारे में पूछें।** आप किसी ऐसी चीज़ के लिए पात्र हो सकते हैं जिसके बारे में आपको पता नहीं था।

segments.src: - **Do not wait for a cutoff.** If you receive a notice, respond early and keep copies.
segments.tr: - **कटौती का इंतजार न करें।** यदि आपको कोई नोटिस मिलता है, तो जल्दी जवाब दें और प्रतियां अपने पास रखें।

segments.src: - **Use local help.** Food banks, community action agencies, legal aid groups and 211 can help with applications, appeals and emergency food.
segments.tr: - **स्थानीय सहायता का उपयोग करें।** फूड बैंक, सामुदायिक कार्रवाई एजेंसियां, कानूनी सहायता समूह और 211 आवेदन, अपील और आपातकालीन भोजन में मदद कर सकते Navigational।

segments.src: ## Where to find reliable information
segments.tr: ## विश्वसनीय जानकारी कहाँ से प्राप्त करें

segments.src: - Your state SNAP or human services agency website and hotline
segments.tr: - आपके राज्य की SNAP या मानव सेवा एजेंसी की वेबसाइट और हेल्पलाइन

segments.src: - The USDA Food and Nutrition Service at fns.usda.gov
segments.tr: - fns.usda.gov पर USDA खाद्य और पोषण सेवा

segments.src: - Local food banks and community organizations
segments.tr: - स्थानीय फूड बैंक और सामुदायिक संगठन

segments.src: - Dialing 211 for referrals to local services
segments.tr: - स्थानीय सेवाओं के संदर्भ के लिए 211 डायल करना

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: The changes that take effect this fiscal year affect different people in different ways.
segments.tr: इस वित्तीय वर्ष से लागू होने वाले बदलाव अलग-अलग लोगों को अलग-अलग तरीकों से प्रभावित करते हैं।

segments.src: Some households will see little difference; others may face new work rules, eligibility questions or different benefit amounts.
segments.tr: कुछ परिवारों को बहुत कम अंतर दिखाई देगा; दूसरों को नए काम के नियमों, पात्रता के सवालों या अलग लाभ राशि का सामना करना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: Because rules and timelines vary by state, the most useful step is to check directly with your state agency, keep your paperwork organized and respond to notices promptly.
segments.tr: चूंकि नियम और समय सीमा राज्य के अनुसार भिन्न होती है, इसलिए सबसे उपयोगी कदम सीधे अपनी राज्य एजेंसी से जांच करना, अपनी कागजी कार्रवाई को व्यवस्थित रखना और नोटिसों का तुरंत जवाब देना है।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not legal, financial or benefits advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और यह कानूनी, वित्तीय या लाभ संबंधी सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: For guidance on your specific situation, contact your state SNAP agency or a qualified professional.*
segments.tr: अपनी विशिष्ट स्थिति पर मार्गदर्शन के लिए, अपने राज्य की SNAP एजेंसी या किसी योग्य पेशेवर से संपर्क करें।*

es.title: Los cambios en SNAP entran en vigor el 1 de octubre: Lo que los hogares, los estados y las tiendas de comestibles deben saber

segments.src: A new federal fiscal year began on October 1, and with it came another stage of changes to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), the nation's largest food assistance program.
segments.tr: Un nuevo año fiscal federal comenzó el 1 de octubre, y con él llegó otra etapa de cambios en el Programa de Asistencia Nutricional Suplementaria (SNAP, por sus siglas en inglés), el programa de asistencia alimentaria más grande de la nación.

segments.src: Recipients, state agencies and grocery retailers are all adjusting.
segments.tr: Los beneficiarios, las agencias estatales y los minoristas de comestibles se están ajustando.

segments.src: This guide explains who is affected, what may look different at the checkout and in the application process, and where to get reliable, current information.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica quién se ve afectado, qué puede parecer diferente al pagar y en el proceso de solicitud, y dónde obtener información confiable y actual.

segments.src: > **A note on accuracy:** SNAP rules are set by federal law but administered by states, so timing and details can differ by state. Treat this article as a general overview and confirm specifics with your state SNAP agency.
segments.tr: > **Una nota sobre la precisión:** Las reglas de SNAP son establecidas por la ley federal pero administradas por los estados, por lo que el momento y los detalles pueden variar según el estado. Trate este artículo como una descripción general y confirme los detalles específicos con su agencia estatal de SNAP.

segments.src: ## Why the changes are happening now
segments.tr: ## Por qué ocurren los cambios ahora

segments.src: Many of the recent adjustments trace back to the federal budget and tax law signed in July 2025, which made several changes to SNAP eligibility and financing.
segments.tr: Muchos de los ajustes recientes se remontan al presupuesto federal y a la ley fiscal firmada en julio de 2025, que realizó varios cambios en la elegibilidad y el financiamiento de SNAP.

segments.src: Some provisions took effect soon after enactment.
segments.tr: Algunas disposiciones entraron en vigor poco después de su promulgación.

segments.src: Others are phased in on the start of a fiscal year, which is why October 1 is an important date for administrators and participants alike.
segments.tr: Otras se implementan gradualmente al comienzo de un año fiscal, razón por la cual el 1 de octubre es una fecha importante tanto para los administradores como para los participantes.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Quién se ve afectado

segments.src: ### Adults subject to work requirements
segments.tr: ### Adultos sujetos a requisitos laborales

segments.src: Federal rules have long required certain adults without dependents to work or take part in qualifying activities for a minimum number of hours per week to keep benefits beyond a limited period.
segments.tr: Las reglas federales han requerido durante mucho tiempo que ciertos adultos sin dependientes trabajen o participen en actividades calificadas durante un número mínimo de horas por semana para mantener los beneficios más allá de un período limitado.

segments.src: Recent changes widened the group of people who must meet these rules and narrowed some of the exemptions that previously applied.
segments.tr: Los cambios recientes ampliaron el grupo de personas que deben cumplir con estas reglas y redujeron algunas de las exenciones que se aplicaban anteriormente.

segments.src: Depending on your situation, the requirements may now apply to:
segments.tr: Dependiendo de su situación, los requisitos ahora pueden aplicarse a:

segments.src: - Older adults in a higher age range than before
segments.tr: - Adultos mayores en un rango de edad más alto que antes

segments.src: - Some parents whose children are older than a certain age

segments.src: ### Households with utility costs
segments.tr: ### Hogares con costos de servicios públicos

segments.src: SNAP benefit amounts take into account certain housing and utility expenses.
segments.tr: Los montos de los beneficios de SNAP tienen en cuenta ciertos gastos de vivienda y servicios públicos.

segments.src: Changes to how some utility costs are counted, including how internet costs and energy-assistance links are treated, can alter the deductions a household receives.
segments.tr: Los cambios en la forma en que se cuentan algunos costos de servicios públicos, incluida la forma en que se tratan los costos de Internet y los vínculos con la asistencia energética, pueden alterar las deducciones que recibe un hogar.

segments.src: For some households, that may mean a different monthly benefit.
segments.tr: Para algunos hogares, eso puede significar un beneficio mensual diferente.

segments.src: Households with elderly or disabled members may be treated differently from others.
segments.tr: Los hogares con miembros ancianos o discapacitados pueden ser tratados de manera diferente a otros.

segments.src: ## What changes at the checkout
segments.tr: ## Qué cambia al pagar

segments.src: For most shoppers, using an EBT card at the register works the way it did before.
segments.tr: Para la mayoría de los compradores, usar una tarjeta EBT en la caja funciona como antes.

segments.src: A few things are worth knowing:
segments.tr: Vale la pena saber algunas cosas:

segments.src: - **Eligible items remain the same in most places.** SNAP still covers food for home preparation, such as produce, meat, dairy, grains and pantry staples. It does not cover alcohol, tobacco, hot prepared foods or non-food items.
segments.tr: - **Los artículos elegibles siguen siendo los mismos en la mayoría de los lugares.** SNAP todavía cubre alimentos para la preparación en el hogar, como productos agrícolas, carne, lácteos, granos y alimentos básicos de despensa. No cubre alcohol, tabaco, alimentos preparados calientes ni artículos que no sean alimentos.

segments.src: - **Some states are testing purchase restrictions.** A number of states have sought federal approval to limit SNAP purchases of items such as soda or candy. If your state has such a waiver, you may see certain products declined at checkout. Your state agency will publish the start date and the list of affected items.
segments.tr: - **Algunos estados están probando restricciones de compra.** Varios estados han buscado la aprobación federal para limitar las compras de SNAP de artículos como refrescos o dulces. Si su estado tiene tal exención, es posible que vea que ciertos productos son rechazados al pagar. Su agencia estatal publicará la fecha de inicio y la lista de artículos afectados.

segments.src: - **Benefit amounts may differ.** If your monthly benefit has changed, you will see it reflected when funds are loaded onto your card. Check your balance through your state EBT app or the number on the back of your card before you shop.
segments.tr: - **Los montos de los beneficios pueden diferir.** Si su beneficio mensual ha cambiado, lo verá reflejado cuando se carguen los fondos en su tarjeta. Verifique su saldo a través de la aplicación EBT de su estado o el número al dorso de su tarjeta antes de comprar.

segments.src: - **Card security matters.** Card skimming and theft have been a concern in several states. Checking your balance regularly, changing your PIN and reporting problems quickly can help. Ask your state agency about replacement policies if benefits are stolen.
segments.tr: - **La seguridad de la tarjeta es importante.** El robo y la clonación de tarjetas han sido una preocupación en varios estados. Verificar su saldo regularmente, cambiar su PIN e informar problemas rápidamente puede ayudar. Pregunte a su agencia estatal sobre las políticas de reemplazo si le roban los beneficios.

segments.src: ## What changes in the application and renewal process
segments.tr: ## Qué cambia en el proceso de solicitud y renovación

segments.src: Applicants and current recipients may notice more paperwork and more follow-up:
segments.tr: Los solicitantes y los beneficiarios actuales pueden notar más papeleo y más seguimiento:

segments.src: 1. **Documentation.** Expect requests to verify work hours, exemptions, immigration status or expenses. Keep pay stubs, medical notes, lease and utility bills ready.
segments.tr: 1. **Documentación.** Espere solicitudes para verificar las horas de trabajo, las exenciones, el estatus migratorio o los gastos. Tenga listos los talones de pago, las notas médicas, el contrato de arrendamiento y las facturas de servicios públicos.

segments.src: 2. **Notices and deadlines.** Watch your mail, email and state benefits portal. Missing a notice or deadline is one of the most common reasons benefits are interrupted.
segments.tr: 2. **Avisos y plazos.** Esté atento a su correo postal, correo electrónico y al portal de beneficios del estado. Perder un aviso o un plazo es una de las razones más comunes por las que se interrumpen los beneficios.

segments.src: 3. **Interviews.** Many states still require an interview at application and recertification. Confirm your appointment and respond promptly if you need to reschedule.
segments.tr: 3. **Entrevistas.** Muchos estados todavía requieren una entrevista al momento de la solicitud y la recertificación. Confirme su cita y responda rápidamente si necesita reprogramarla.

segments.src: 4. **Reporting changes.** Changes in income, household size or work hours may need to be reported on a schedule set by your state.
segments.tr: 4. **Informar cambios.** Los cambios en los ingresos, el tamaño del hogar o las horas de trabajo pueden tener que informarse en un cronograma establecido por su estado.

segments.src: 5. **Appeals.** If you receive a denial or reduction you believe is wrong, you generally have the right to request a fair hearing. The notice should include the deadline and instructions.
segments.tr: 5. **Apelaciones.** Si recibe una denegación o reducción que cree que es incorrecta, generalmente tiene derecho a solicitar una audiencia justa. El aviso debe incluir la fecha límite y las instrucciones.

segments.src: ## What states are dealing with
segments.tr: ## Con qué están lidiando los estados

segments.src: States run SNAP day to day, and the financing structure is shifting.
segments.tr: Los estados administran SNAP día a día, y la estructura de financiamiento está cambiando.

segments.src: Beginning in fiscal year 2027, the federal share of state administrative costs is scheduled to fall, leaving states to cover a larger portion of the expense of processing applications, verifying eligibility and operating call centers.
segments.tr: A partir del año fiscal 2027, la parte federal de los costos administrativos estatales está programada para disminuir, dejando que los estados cubran una mayor parte de los gastos de procesamiento de solicitudes, verificación de elegibilidad y operación de centros de llamadas.

segments.src: Further changes tied to state payment error rates and benefit cost sharing are scheduled in later years.
segments.tr: Otros cambios vinculados a las tasas de error de pago estatales y al costo compartido de los beneficios están programados para años posteriores.

segments.src: State agencies have responded in different ways, including updating computer systems, training staff, hiring or reallocating workers, and notifying participants.
segments.tr: Las agencias estatales han respondido de diferentes maneras, incluyendo la actualización de sistemas informáticos, la capacitación del personal, la contratación o reasignación de trabajadores y la notificación a los participantes.

segments.src: Advocates and some officials have raised concerns about processing delays and wait times.
segments.tr: Los defensores y algunos funcionarios han expresado su preocupación por los retrasos en el procesamiento y los tiempos de espera.

segments.src: Others argue the changes encourage accuracy and work participation.
segments.tr: Otros argumentan que los cambios fomentan la precisión y la participación laboral.

segments.src: Either way, the practical effect for families can vary widely depending on where they live.
segments.tr: De cualquier manera, el efecto práctico para las familias puede variar ampliamente según dónde vivan.

segments.src: ## What grocers and retailers are doing
segments.tr: ## Qué están haciendo las tiendas de comestibles y los minoristas

segments.src: Authorized SNAP retailers, from large chains to corner stores and farmers markets, are updating point-of-sale systems and staff training.
segments.tr: Los minoristas autorizados de SNAP, desde grandes cadenas hasta tiendas de barrio y mercados de agricultores, están actualizando los sistemas de punto de venta y la capacitación del personal.

segments.src: Key points for retailers:
segments.tr: Puntos clave para los minoristas:

segments.src: - Follow state guidance on any product restrictions and update registers accordingly.
segments.tr: - Siga la guía estatal sobre cualquier restricción de productos y actualice las cajas registradoras en consecuencia.

segments.src: - Train cashiers to explain declined items calmly, since shoppers may be surprised.
segments.tr: - Capacite a los cajeros para que expliquen los artículos rechazados con calma, ya que los compradores pueden sorprenderse.

segments.src: - Watch for changes in sales volume if household benefits shift in your area.
segments.tr: - Esté atento a los cambios en el volumen de ventas si los beneficios de los hogares cambian en su área.

segments.src: - Keep informed through USDA Food and Nutrition Service retailer resources.
segments.tr: - Manténgase informado a través de los recursos para minoristas del Servicio de Alimentos y Nutrición del USDA.

segments.src: ## Practical steps for households
segments.tr: ## Pasos prácticos para los hogares

segments.src: - **Log in or call now.** Verify your case status, benefit amount and any upcoming deadline.
segments.tr: - **Inicie sesión o llame ahora.** Verifique el estado de su caso, el monto del beneficio y cualquier fecha límite próxima.

segments.src: - **Gather documents.** Proof of work hours, exemptions, income and expenses can speed up decisions.
segments.tr: - **Reúna documentos.** La prueba de las horas de trabajo, las exenciones, los ingresos y los gastos puede acelerar las decisiones.

segments.src: - **Ask about exemptions and deductions.** You may qualify for something you did not know about.
segments.tr: - **Pregunte sobre exenciones y deducciones.** Es posible que califique para algo que no conocía.

segments.src: - **Do not wait for a cutoff.** If you receive a notice, respond early and keep copies.
segments.tr: - **No espere a un corte.** Si recibe un aviso, responda temprano y guarde copias.

segments.src: - **Use local help.** Food banks, community action agencies, legal aid groups and 211 can help with applications, appeals and emergency food.
segments.tr: - **Utilice ayuda local.** Los bancos de alimentos, las agencias de acción comunitaria, los grupos de asistencia legal y el 211 pueden ayudar con las solicitudes, las apelaciones y la alimentación de emergencia.

segments.src: ## Where to find reliable information
segments.tr: ## Dónde encontrar información confiable

segments.src: - Your state SNAP or human services agency website and hotline
segments.tr: - El sitio web y la línea directa de su agencia estatal de SNAP o de servicios humanos

segments.src: - The USDA Food and Nutrition Service at fns.usda.gov
segments.tr: - El Servicio de Alimentos y Nutrición del USDA en fns.usda.gov

segments.src: - Local food banks and community organizations
segments.tr: - Bancos de alimentos locales y organizaciones comunitarias

segments.src: - Dialing 211 for referrals to local services
segments.tr: - Marcar 211 para referencias a servicios locales

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: The changes that take effect this fiscal year affect different people in different ways.
segments.tr: Los cambios que entran en vigor este año fiscal afectan a diferentes personas de diferentes maneras.

segments.src: Some households will see little difference; others may face new work rules, eligibility questions or different benefit amounts.
segments.tr: Algunos hogares verán poca diferencia; otros pueden enfrentar nuevas reglas laborales, preguntas de elegibilidad o diferentes montos de beneficios.

segments.src: Because rules and timelines vary by state, the most useful step is to check directly with your state agency, keep your paperwork organized and respond to notices promptly.
segments.tr: Debido a que las reglas y los plazos varían según el estado, el paso más útil es consultar directamente con su agencia estatal, mantener su papeleo organizado y responder a los avisos con prontitud.

ar.title: تغييرات برنامج SNAP تدخل دخل التنفيذ في 1 أكتوبر: ما تحتاج الأسر والولايات ومتاجر البقالة إلى معرفته

segments.src: A new federal fiscal year began on October 1, and with it came another stage of changes to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), the nation's largest food assistance program.
segments.tr: بدأت سنة مالية اتحادية جديدة في 1 أكتوبر، ومعها جاءت مرحلة أخرى من التغييرات في برنامج المساعدة الغذائية التكميلية (SNAP)، وهو أكبر برنامج للمساعدة الغذائية في الدولة.

segments.src: Recipients, state agencies and grocery retailers are all adjusting.
segments.tr: ويتكيف المستفيدون وكالة الولاية وتجار التجزئة للبقالة جميعاً مع هذا الوضع.

segments.src: This guide explains who is affected, what may look different at the checkout and in the application process, and where to get reliable, current information.
segments.tr: يشرح هذا الدليل المتأثرين، وما قد تبدو عليه الأمور بشكل مختلف عند الدفع وفي عملية التقديم، وأين يمكن الحصول على معلومات موثوقة وحديثة.

segments.src: > **A note on accuracy:** SNAP rules are set by federal law but administered by states, so timing and details can differ by state. Treat this article as a general overview and confirm specifics with your state SNAP agency.
segments.tr: > **ملاحظة حول الدقة:** يتم تحديد قواعد برنامج (SNAP) بموجب القانون الفيدرالي ولكن تديرها الولايات، لذا يمكن أن يختلف التوقيت والتفاصيل حسب الولاية. تعامل مع هذه المقالة ك نظرة عامة وتأكد من التفاصيل مع وكالة (SNAP) في ولايتك.

segments.src: ## Why the changes are happening now
segments.tr: ## لماذا تحدث التغييرات الآن

segments.src: Many of the recent adjustments trace back to the federal budget and tax law signed in July 2025, which made several changes to SNAP eligibility and financing.
segments.tr: العديد من التعديلات الأخيرة تعود إلى الميزانية الفيدرالية وقانون الضرائب المبرم في يوليو 2025، والذي أجرى عدة تغييرات على أهلية (SNAP) وتمويله.

segments.src: Some provisions took effect soon after enactment.
segments.tr: دخلت بعض الأحكام حيز التنفيذ بعد الإقرار بفترة قصيرة.

segments.src: Others are phased in on the start of a fiscal year, which is why October 1 is an important date for administrators and participants alike.
segments.tr: ويتم تطبيق أمور أخرى تدريجياً في بداية السنة المالية، ولهذا السبب يعتبر 1 أكتوبر تاريخاً هاماً لكل من المسؤولين والمشاركين على حد سواء.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## من المتأثر

segments.src: ### Adults subject to work requirements
segments.tr: ### البالغون الخاضعون لمتطلبات العمل

segments.src: Federal rules have long required certain adults without dependents to work or take part in qualifying activities for a minimum number of hours per week to keep benefits beyond a limited period.
segments.tr: طلبت القواعد الفيدرالية لفترة طويلة من بعض البالغين الذين ليس لديهم معالون العمل أو المشاركة في أنشطة مؤهلة لعدد أدنى من الساعات أسبوعياً للاحتفاظ بالمزايا بعد فترة محدودة.

segments.src: Recent changes widened the group of people who must meet these rules and narrowed some of the exemptions that previously applied.
segments.tr: وسعت التغييرات الأخيرة مجموعة الأشخاص الذين يجب أن يستوفوا هذه القواعد وقللت بعض الإعفاءات التي كانت تنطبق سابقاً.

segments.src: Depending on your situation, the requirements may now apply to:
segments.tr: اعتماداً على وضعك، قد تنطبق المتطلبات الآن على:

segments.src: - Older adults in a higher age range than before
segments.tr: - الكبار في سن أعلى من ذي قبل

segments.src: - Some parents whose children are older than a certain age
segments.tr: - بعض الآباء والأمهات الذين تجاوز أطفالهم عمراً معيناً

segments.src: - People in groups that previously qualified for exemptions
segments.tr: - الأشخاص في مجموعات كانت مؤهلة سابقاً للاعفاءات

segments.src: Exemptions still exist, including for people who are medically unable to work, pregnant, or caring for young children or an incapacitated household member.
segments.tr: لا تزال الإعفاءات موجودة، بما في ذلك للأشخاص الذين يعانون من عجز طبي عن العمل، أو الحوامل، أو الذين يعتنون بأطفال صغار أو أحد أفراد الأسرة غير العاجزين.

segments.src: If you think you qualify for an exemption, ask your caseworker how to document it.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تعتقد أنك مؤهل للاعفاء، فاسأل الأخصائي الاجتماعي الخاص بك عن كيفية توثيقه.

segments.src: ### Certain noncitizens
segments.tr: ### بعض غير المواطنين

segments.src: Eligibility categories for some lawfully present noncitizens have been narrowed.
segments.tr: تم تقليص فئات الأهلية لبعض غير المواطنين المقيمين بشكل قانوني.

segments.src: Households with mixed immigration status should check with their state agency or a trusted legal aid or community organization before assuming they are or are not eligible.
segments.tr: يجب على الأسر ذات وضع الهجرة المختلط التحقق من وكالة الولاية أو منظمة قانونية أو مجتمعية موثوقة قبل افتراض ما إذا كانوا مؤهلين أم لا.

segments.src: ### Households with utility costs
segments.tr: تأخذ مبالغ مزايا (SNAP) في الاعتبار نفقات السكن والمرافق المعينة.

segments.src: SNAP benefit amounts take into account certain housing and utility expenses.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تؤدي التغييرات في كيفية احتساب بعض تكاليف المرافق، بما في ذلك كيفية معاملة تكاليف الإنترنت وروابط مساعدة الطاقة، إلى تغيير الخصومات التي تتلقاها الأسرة.

segments.src: Changes to how some utility costs are counted, including how internet costs and energy-assistance links are treated, can alter the deductions a household receives.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لبعض الأسر، قد يعني ذلك ميزة شهرية مختلفة.

segments.src: For some households, that may mean a different monthly benefit.
segments.tr: قد يتم التعامل مع الأسر التي تضم أفراداً مسنين أو ذوي إعاقة بشكل مختلف عن الآخرين.

segments.src: Households with elderly or disabled members may be treated differently from others.
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يتغير عند الدفع

segments.src: ## What changes at the checkout
segments.tr: بالنسبة لمعظم المتسوقين، فإن استخدام بطاقة EBT عند الدفع يعمل بالطريقة التي كان عليها من قبل.

segments.src: For most shoppers, using an EBT card at the register works the way it did before.
segments.tr: هناك أشياء قليلة تستحق المعرفة:

segments.src: A few things are worth knowing:
segments.tr: - **العناصر المؤهلة تظل كما هي في معظم الأماكن.** لا يزال برنامج (SNAP) يغطي الطعام لإعداده في المنزل، مثل المنتجات الطازجة واللحوم والألجبان والحبوب والمواد الأساسية في المؤونة. وهو لا يغطي الكحول أو التبغ أو الأطعمة الساخنة المعدة أو العناصر غير الغذائية.

segments.src: - **Eligible items remain the same in most places.** SNAP still covers food for home preparation, such as produce, meat, dairy, grains and pantry staples. It does not cover alcohol, tobacco, hot prepared foods or non-food items.
segments.tr: - **بعض الولايات تختبر قيود الشراء.** سعت عدد من الولايات للحصول على موافقة اتحادية للحد من مشتريات (SNAP) من عناصر مثل الصودا أو الحلوى. إذا كان لدى ولايتك مثل هذا الإعفاء، فقد ترى رفض بعض المنتجات عند الدفع. ستقوم وكالة ولايتك بنشر تاريخ البدء وقائمة العناصر المتأثرة.

segments.src: - **Some states are testing purchase restrictions.** A number of states have sought federal approval to limit SNAP purchases of items such as soda or candy. If your state has such a waiver, you may see certain products declined at checkout. Your state agency will publish the start date and the list of affected items.
segments.tr: - **قد تختلف مبالغ المزايا.** إذا تغيرت مزاياك الشهرية، فسوف ترَى ذلك منعكساً عندما يتم تحميل الأموال على بطاقتك. تحقق من رصيدك من خلال تطبيق EBT لولاكتك أو الرقم الموجود على ظهر بطاقتك قبل التسوق.

segments.src: - **Benefit amounts may differ.** If your monthly benefit has changed, you will see it reflected when funds are loaded onto your card. Check your balance through your state EBT app or the number on the back of your card before you shop.
segments.tr: - **أمن البطاقات مهم.** كان استنساخ البطاقات والسرقة مدعاة للقلق في عدة ولايات. التحقق من رصيدك بانتظام وتغيير رقم التعريف الشخصي والإبلاغ عن المشكلات بسرعة يمكن أن يساعد. اسأل وكالة ولايتك عن سياسات الاستبدال إذا سرقت المزايا.

segments.src: - **Card security matters.** Card skimming and theft have been a concern in several states. Checking your balance regularly, changing your PIN and reporting problems quickly can help. Ask your state agency about replacement policies if benefits are stolen.
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يتغير في عملية التقديم والتجديد

segments.src: ## What changes in the application and renewal process
segments.tr: قد يلاحظ المتقدمون والمستفيدون الحاليون المزيد من الأوراق والمزيد من المتابعة:

fr.title: SNAP : Les changements entrent en vigueur le 1er octobre ; ce que les ménages, les États et les épiceries doivent savoir

segments.src: A new federal fiscal year began on October 1, and with it came another stage of changes to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), the nation's largest food assistance program.
segments.tr: Un nouvel exercice budgétaire fédéral a commencé le 1er octobre, apportant avec lui une nouvelle série de modifications au Programme d'aide nutritionnelle complémentaire (SNAP), le plus grand programme d'aide alimentaire du pays.

segments.src: Recipients, state agencies and grocery retailers are all adjusting.
segments.tr: Les bénéficiaires, les agences étatiques et les détaillants en alimentation s'adaptent tous.

segments.src: This guide explains who is affected, what may look different at the checkout and in the application process, and where to get reliable, current information.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique qui est concerné, ce qui peut sembler différent à la caisse et dans le processus de demande, et où obtenir des informations fiables et actuelles.

segments.src: > **A note on accuracy:** SNAP rules are set by federal law but administered by states, so timing and details can differ by state. Treat this article as a general overview and confirm specifics with your state SNAP agency.
segments.tr: > **Remarque sur l'exactitude :** Les règles du SNAP sont fixées par la loi fédérale mais administrées par les États, de sorte que le calendrier et les détails peuvent varier selon l'État. Considérez cet article comme un aperçu général et confirmez les spécificités auprès de l'agence SNAP de votre État.

segments.src: ## Why the changes are happening now
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ces changements ont lieu maintenant

segments.src: Many of the recent adjustments trace back to the federal budget and tax law signed in July 2025, which made several changes to SNAP eligibility and financing.
segments.tr: Bon nombre des ajustements récents trouvent leur origine dans le budget fédéral et la loi fiscale signés en juillet 2025, qui ont apporté plusieurs modifications à l'admissibilité et au financement du SNAP.

segments.src: Some provisions took effect soon after enactment.
segments.tr: Certaines dispositions sont entrées en vigueur peu de temps après leur promulgation.

segments.src: Others are phased in on the start of a fiscal year, which is why October 1 is an important date for administrators and participants alike.
segments.tr: D'autres sont introduites progressivement au début d'un exercice budgétaire, c'est pourquoi le 1er octobre est une date importante tant pour les administrateurs que pour les participants.

segments.src: ## Who is affected
segments.tr: ## Qui est concerné

segments.src: ### Adults subject to work requirements
segments.tr: ### Adultes soumis à des exigences professionnelles

segments.src: Federal rules have long required certain adults without dependents to work or take part in qualifying activities for a minimum number of hours per week to keep benefits beyond a limited period.
segments.tr: Les règles fédérales exigent depuis longtemps de certains adultes sans personnes à charge qu'ils travaillent ou participent à des activités admissibles pendant un nombre minimal d'heures par semaine pour conserver leurs prestations au-delà d'une période limitée.

segments.src: Recent changes widened the group of people who must meet these rules and narrowed some of the exemptions that previously applied.
segments.tr: Les changements récents ont élargi le groupe de personnes qui doivent respecter ces règles et restreint certaines des exemptions qui s'appliquaient auparavant.

segments.src: Depending on your situation, the requirements may now apply to:
segments.tr: Selon votre situation, les exigences peuvent désormais s'appliquer à :

segments.src: - Older adults in a higher age range than before
segments.tr: - Les adultes plus âgés dans une tranche d'âge supérieure à celle d'avant

segments.src: - Some parents whose children are older than a certain age
segments.tr: - Certains parents dont les enfants sont plus âgés qu'un certain âge

segments.src: - People in groups that previously qualified for exemptions
segments.tr: - Les personnes appartenant à des groupes qui bénéficiaient auparavant d'exemptions

segments.src: Exemptions still exist, including for people who are medically unable to work, pregnant, or caring for young children or an incapacitated household member.
segments.tr: Des exemptions existent toujours, notamment pour les personnes qui sont médicalement inaptes au travail, enceintes, ou qui s'occupent de jeunes enfants ou d'un membre de la famille invalide.

segments.src: If you think you qualify for an exemption, ask your caseworker how to document it.
segments.tr: Si vous pensez avoir droit à une exempion, demandez à votre travailleur social comment le documenter.

segments.src: ### Certain noncitizens
segments.tr: ### Certains non-citoyens

segments.src: Eligibility categories for some lawfully present noncitizens have been narrowed.
segments.tr: Les catégories d'admissibilité pour certains non-citoyens résidant légalement ont été restreintes.

segments.src: Households with mixed immigration status should check with their state agency or a trusted legal aid or community organization before assuming they are or are not eligible.
segments.tr: Les ménages ayant un statut d'immigration mixte devraient consulter l'agence de leur État ou un organisme d'aide juridique ou communautaire de confiance avant de supposer qu'ils sont ou ne sont pas admissibles.

segments.tr: Il est important de noter que les enfants citoyens des États-Unis

segments.src: citizen children in a household generally keep their own eligibility.
segments.tr: présents dans un ménage conservent généralement leur propre admissibilité.

segments.src: ### Households with utility costs
segments.tr: ### Ménages ayant des frais de services publics

segments.src: SNAP benefit amounts take into account certain housing and utility expenses.
segments.tr: Le montant des prestations SNAP prend en compte certaines dépenses de logement et de services publics.

segments.src: Changes to how some utility costs are counted, including how internet costs and energy-assistance links are treated, can alter the deductions a household receives.
segments.tr: Les modifications apportées à la manière dont certains coûts de services publics sont comptabilisés, y compris le traitement des frais d'Internet et des liens d'aide énergétique, peuvent modifier les déductions reçues par un ménage.

segments.src: For some households, that may mean a different monthly benefit.
segments.tr: Pour certains ménages, cela peut signifier une prestation mensuelle différente.

segments.src: Households with elderly or disabled members may be treated differently from others.
segments.tr: Les ménages comptant des membres âgés ou handicapés peuvent être traités différemment des autres.

segments.src: ## What changes at the checkout
segments.tr: ## Ce qui change à la caisse

segments.src: For most shoppers, using an EBT card at the register works the way it did before.
segments.tr: Pour la plupart des acheteurs, l'utilisation d'une carte EBT à la caisse fonctionne comme avant.

segments.src: A few things are worth knowing:
segments.tr: Quelques points sont à retenir :

segments.src: - **Eligible items remain the same in most places.** SNAP still covers food for home preparation, such as produce, meat, dairy, grains and pantry staples. It does not cover alcohol, tobacco, hot prepared foods or non-food items.
segments.tr: - **Les articles admissibles restent les mêmes dans la plupart des endroits.** Le SNAP couvre toujours les aliments destinés à la préparation à domicile, tels que les produits frais, la viande, les produits laitiers, les céréales et les produits de base. Il ne couvre pas l'alcool, le tabac, les aliments chauds préparés ou les articles non alimentaires.

segments.src: - **Some states are testing purchase restrictions.** A number of states have sought federal approval to limit SNAP purchases of items such as soda or candy. If your state has such a waiver, you may see certain products declined at checkout. Your state agency will publish the start date and the list of affected items.
segments.tr: - **Certains États testent des restrictions d'achat.** Un certain nombre d'États ont demandé l'approbation fédérale pour limiter les achats SNAP d'articles tels que les sodas ou les bonbons. Si votre État dispose d'une telle dérogation, vous constaterez peut-être que certains produits sont refusés à la caisse. L'agence de votre État publiera la date de début et la liste des articles concernés.

segments.src: - **Benefit amounts may differ.** If your monthly benefit has changed, you will see it reflected when funds are loaded onto your card. Check your balance through your state EBT app or the number on the back of your card before you shop.
segments.tr: - **Le montant des prestations peut différer.** Si votre prestation mensuelle a changé, vous le verrez reflété lorsque les fonds seront chargés sur votre carte. Vérifiez votre solde via l'application EBT de votre État ou le numéro au dos de votre carte avant de faire vos achats.

segments.src: - **Card security matters.** Card skimming and theft have been a concern in several states. Checking your balance regularly, changing your PIN and reporting problems quickly can help. Ask your state agency about replacement policies if benefits are stolen.
segments.tr: - **La sécurité des cartes est importante.** Le piratage de cartes et le vol ont été une source de préoccupation dans plusieurs États. Vérifier régulièrement votre solde, changer votre code PIN et signaler rapidement les problèmes peut aider. Renseignez-vous auprès de l'agence de votre État sur les politiques de remplacement si des prestations sont volées.

segments.src: ## What changes in the application and renewal process
segments.tr: ## Ce qui change dans le processus de demande et de renouvellement

segments.src: Applicants and current recipients may notice more paperwork and more follow-up:
segments.tr: Les demandeurs et les bénéficiaires actuels peuvent s'attendre à plus de paperasse et à un suivi accru :

segments.src: 1. **Documentation.** Expect requests to verify work hours, exemptions, immigration status or expenses. Keep pay stubs, medical notes, lease and utility bills ready.
segments.tr: 1. **Documentation.** Attendez-vous à des demandes de vérification des heures de travail, des exemptions, du statut d'immigration ou des dépenses. Gardez à portée de main les bulletins de paie, les notes médicales, le bail et les factures de services publics.

segments.src: 2. **Notices and deadlines.** Watch your mail, email and state benefits portal. Missing a notice or deadline is one of the most common reasons benefits are interrupted.
segments.tr: 2. **Avis et délais.** Surveillez votre courrier, vos e-mails et le portail des prestations de votre État. Manquer un avis ou un délai est l'une des raisons les plus fréquentes d'interruption des prestations.

segments.src: 3. **Interviews.** Many states still require an interview at application and recertification. Confirm your appointment and respond promptly if you need to reschedule.
segments.tr: 3. **Entretiens.** De nombreux États exigent toujours un entretien lors de la demande et du renouvellement. Confirmez votre rendez-vous et répondez rapidement si vous devez le reporter.

segments.src: 4. **Reporting changes.** Changes in income, household size or work hours may need to be reported on a schedule set by your state.
segments.tr: 4. **Signalement des changements.** Les changements de revenus, de taille du ménage ou d'heures de travail devront peut-être être signalés selon un calendrier fixé par votre État.

segments.src: 5. **Appeals.** If you receive a denial or reduction you believe is wrong, you generally have the right to request a fair hearing. The notice should include the deadline and instructions.
segments.tr: 5. **Appels.** Si vous recevez un refus ou une réduction que vous estimez injustifié, vous avez généralement le droit de demander une audience équitable. L'avis doit inclure la date limite et les instructions.

segments.src: ## What states are dealing with
segments.tr: ## Ce à quoi les États font face

segments.src: States run SNAP day to day, and the financing structure is shifting.
segments.tr: Les États gèrent le SNAP au jour le jour, et la structure de financement est en train de changer.

segments.src: Beginning in fiscal year 2027, the federal share of state administrative costs is scheduled to fall, leaving states to cover a larger portion of the expense of processing applications, verifying eligibility and operating call centers.
segments.tr: À compter de l'exercice 2027, la part fédérale des coûts administratifs des États devrait diminuer, laissant aux États la charge de couvrir une plus grande partie des dépenses liées au traitement des demandes, à la vérification de l'admissibilité et au fonctionnement des centres d'appels.

segments.src: Further changes tied to state payment error rates and benefit cost sharing are scheduled in later years.
segments.tr: D'autres changements liés aux taux d'erreur de paiement des États et au partage des coûts des prestations sont prévus pour les années suivantes.

segments.src: State agencies have responded in different ways, including updating computer systems, training staff, hiring or reallocating workers, and notifying participants.
segments.tr: Les agences étatiques ont réagi de différentes manières, notamment en mettant à jour les systèmes informatiques, en formant le personnel, en embauchant ou en réaffectant des travailleurs et en informant les participants.

segments.src: Advocates and some officials have raised concerns about processing delays and wait times.
segments.tr: Des défenseurs et certains fonctionnaires ont exprimé des inquiétudes concernant les retards de traitement et les temps d'attente.

segments.src: Others argue the changes encourage accuracy and work participation.
segments.tr: D'autres soutiennent que les changements encouragent l'exactitude et la participation au travail.

segments.src: Either way, the practical effect for families can vary widely depending on where they live.
segments.tr: Quoi qu'il en soit, l'effet pratique pour les familles peut varier considérablement selon l'endroit où elles vivent.

segments.src: ## What grocers and retailers are doing
segments.tr: ## Ce que font les épiceries et les détaillants

segments.src: Authorized SNAP retailers, from large chains to corner stores and farmers markets, are updating point-of-sale systems and staff training.
segments.tr: Les détaillants agréés SNAP, des grandes chaînes aux petits magasins de quartier et aux marchés de producteurs, mettent à jour leurs systèmes de point de vente et la formation de leur personnel.

segments.src: Key points for retailers:
segments.tr: Points clés pour les détaillants :

segments.src: - Follow state guidance on any product restrictions and update registers accordingly.
segments.tr: - Suivre les directives de l'État concernant toute restriction de produits et mettre à jour les caisses en conséquence.

segments.src: - Train cashiers to explain declined items calmly, since shoppers may be surprised.
segments.tr: - Former les caissiers à expliquer calmement les articles refusés, car les acheteurs peuvent être surpris.

segments.src: - Watch for changes in sales volume if household benefits shift in your area.
segments.tr: - Surveiller les changements de volume des ventes si les prestations des ménages changent dans votre région.

segments.src: - Keep informed through USDA Food and Nutrition Service retailer resources.
segments.tr: - Se tenir informé grâce aux ressources pour les détaillants du Service de l'alimentation et de la nutrition de l'USDA (USDA Food and Nutrition Service).

segments.tr: ## Mesures pratiques pour les ménages

segments.src: - **Log in or call now.** Verify your case status, benefit amount and any upcoming deadline.
segments.tr: - **Connectez-vous ou appelez maintenant.** Vérifiez l'état de votre dossier, le montant de vos prestations et toute date limite à venir.

segments.src: - **Gather documents.** Proof of work hours, exemptions, income and expenses can speed up decisions.
